functions.name: pull_request_review_comments
functions.description: One canonical review comment by repository ID and comment ID across repository lists, PR lists, review lists and direct lookup. Direct/repository responses supply a PR URL but no numeric PR key, so pull_request_number remains NULL there; no parent is invented from URL text. Review IDs and parent comment IDs can be absent. Direct repository and comment-author context are analytical; PR/review/reply parent associations retain navigation without competing analytical paths.

metrics.name: pull_request_review_comment_count
metrics.comment: Visible diff review comments, separate from issue conversation comments.

derived_fields.name: review_comment_created_day
derived_fields.comment: UTC date of the returned created_at instant.

functions.name: pull_request_files
functions.description: Current net changed paths per pull request, distinct from commit-file changes. Filename is scoped by repository and PR; rename retains previous_filename and a missing binary/large-file patch stays NULL. All pages must match the hydrated changed_files count, so the API 3000-file cap or concurrent population changes fail qualification instead of returning complete-looking partial totals.

metrics.name: pull_request_file_count
metrics.comment: Net changed file paths across selected pull requests.

pull_request_file_additions.comment: Added lines in current PR file diffs.

pull_request_file_deletions.comment: Deleted lines in current PR file diffs.

pull_request_file_changes.comment: Total reported changed lines, not distinct repository lines across PRs.

functions.name: pull_request_merge_statuses
functions.description: Merge-check observations after confirming the selected PR is visible. GitHub declares HTTP 204 as merged and 404 as not merged for this endpoint; other failures are not converted to false. This is a current predicate observation, not a merge event history or asynchronous queue outcome.

merged_pull_request_check_count.comment: Merge-check observations with the declared merged HTTP response.

unmerged_pull_request_check_count.comment: Merge-check observations with the declared not-merged HTTP response.

functions.name: pull_request_merge_results
functions.description: Status of an externally supplied asynchronous merge request UUID, retained by GitHub for only 24 hours after its most recent update. Retrieval never performs a merge. Enqueued is a final queue-request result and does not imply eventual merge; pending, failed and merged remain distinct. Nullable detail fields preserve the API variant rather than inventing merge SHAs.

metrics.name: enqueued_async_merge_count
metrics.comment: Asynchronous results finalized as enqueued; not successful merges.

functions.name: pull_request_stacks
functions.description: GHEC-documented pull request stacks at repository ID and stable stack ID, unified across list, stack-number lookup and containing-PR filter. Listing discovers stack numbers and hydrates full stack detail, preserving ordered PR members and head refs/SHAs. Stack openness means any member PR is open; no reviewer or merge eligibility inference is made.

stack_pull_request_membership_count.comment: Ordered stack/PR memberships in selected stacks, not a count of all repository PRs.
